title: Insurance on File and Relief Extension Months for Assisted Patients
content:
Desk guidance for **Patient Payment Plans**: for a patient holding an approved award under the Patient Financial Assistance Program, whether the patient has live insurance on file under Insurance Coverage & Claims bears on relief extension months.

## The rule

A patient with an approved award and no live insurance coverage on file adds 2 relief extension months; a patient with an approved award and a live insurance coverage on file adds 1 relief extension month; any other patient adds none.

Relief extension months are added to the installments still to fall due over which a relief installment spreads the plan's carried balance; months from every source are added together, and the installments with all the relief extension months never carry the plan past its 24th installment.

## Reading the records

- **Approved award** — a case of the patient under the Patient Financial Assistance Program whose status is approved.
- **Live insurance coverage on file** — a coverage of the patient under Insurance Coverage & Claims whose status is active. A coverage that has been terminated is not live.

## Condition, judgement, result

| Approved award | Live (active) coverage on file | Relief extension months |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | 2 |
| Yes | Yes, one or more | 1 |
| No | No | 0 |
| No | Yes | 0 |

## Hypothetical patients

- Approved award; the only coverage on file was terminated last year: no live coverage, 2 months.
- Approved award; a Commercial In-Network Plan coverage active on file: 1 month.
- Approved award; two active coverages on file: still 1 month — the rule asks whether a live coverage is on file, not how many.
- No approved award; no coverage at all: none.
